scenes.headline: No gum in Singapore
scenes.say: Did you know you can't buy chewing gum in Singapore?

scenes.label: SALE BANNED SINCE
scenes.say: Selling it has been banned since nineteen ninety two. Only medical gum, like nicotine gum, is sold in pharmacies. So leave your pack at home.
